title: 第一卷 第15章 难伺候的姑奶奶第一卷 第16章 这是纯友谊
content_zh:
月落鸟啼，夜归晨曦。
卯时尾，辰时初。
阳光透过窗户洒进小屋，在墙上映出斑驳的光影。
陈玄早早睁眼，跳下床拉出陶罐，迫不及待取出罐中的丹药，放在手心一看，不由勾起一抹笑意。
出人意料，丹药直接从废丹变成了紫色品质。
在他推断中，最有可能的是变成绿色灵品，不曾想却是直接成了玄品，如此又有些不符之前的推论，毕竟‘复伤丹’肯定是要比‘辟谷丹’珍贵。
尤其这类治疗丹药还可略微调整所需药材，达到意想不到的效果，甚至有些极品仙丹有生死人肉白骨的功效，是为九转仙丹。
当然这些都是听郸呈说的，也不知真假。
据他所言，丹药分九转，对应成丹的四种品质，所谓九转按陈玄的理解，便是反复提纯次数，提纯一次为凡丹，提纯二、三次为灵丹，提纯四至六次为玄丹，六次以上为仙丹。
也是直接和成丹品质挂钩，却又不是决定性因素。
如霍长老炼丹时，明明是走完了四转流程，却也只得了两枚玄丹，可见提纯次数并不能直接决定成丹品质。
而之所以出现废丹，便是提纯次数过多，导致一些融合灵气不足的丹药，直接失去了药性。
陈玄细细思量，总结经验。
已经决定以后定是要走炼丹的路子，目前来说能发挥陶罐最大功用的方式，也唯有两条：
一是炼丹，即便炼成废丹，也能保证丹药品质。
二是炼器，与炼丹同理。
可炼器终归要附加小型阵纹，对法力操控和手法有较高要求，若是阵纹废了，就只能得到一个加强版的普通物件，于炼气士而言意义不大。
如此，往后的大方向也就确定了，现在所需就是想个办法下山一趟，买几本炼丹相关的书籍看看，再弄着废丹充实底牌库。
说起底牌库，现在也是囊中羞涩，能拿得出手的不过就一个陶罐、栾清萍送的吊坠，以及几枚很一般的丹药罢了。
想在修仙界混得开，除却行事需谨慎，底牌也是必不可少，当然不为人知的才算底牌，别人知晓的顶多算是明牌。

眼下，最紧要的是，把今日要来的那位‘难伺候的姑奶奶’应付过去。
陈玄收回思绪，将陶罐中所有的东西取出，藏在床缝夹层中，又把陶罐推进床底下，才推门走了出去。
郸呈的房门还关着，为时尚早。
陈玄也没闲着，又检查了一遍丹炉，然后开始往丹房中抱柴火。
苏若烟不像霍长老那般习得控火的法术，还是要借助凡间寻常的手段炼丹，柴火也就成了必不可少的东西。
这也是陈玄选择从丹道开始的主要原因之一，没有法力也可烧柴炼制，至于引动天地灵气，在他通感后不久，就已经能做到了。
他要求不高，只要能炼出废丹即可。
搬柴时想及此处，突然有个大胆的、天马行空的念头：
不知将炼丹所需的材料放入陶罐中，能不能直接变成丹药？
嗯……值得一试！
都是后话。
陈玄一趟又一趟搬柴，很快就在丹炉旁堆起一人高的柴堆。
这时，郸呈才姗姗来迟，打着哈欠走进丹房。
看到陈玄已经将柴火码好，不由露出笑意，走过来拍了拍他的肩膀，“干得不错，老弟！”
陈玄捂着脑门笑了笑，见郸呈顶着大大的黑眼圈，便问道，“郸师兄这是干嘛去了，昨夜没睡好吗？”
“嗨，别提了！”
郸呈一摆手，挤了挤眼睛，一手扶住丹炉，道，“昨晚脑子里全是霍长老那句话，搞得我兴奋过了头，一晚上没睡着觉，干脆打坐修行了一夜，却是毫无长进，筑基境，难啊！”
“师兄，加油，相信你可以的！”
content_en:
The moon falls and the birds sing, the night returns to the morning light.
The end of Mao hour and the beginning of Chen hour.
The sun shines into the cabin through the windows, creating mottled light and shadow on the walls.
Chen Xuan opened his eyes early, jumped out of bed and pulled out the clay pot. He couldn't wait to take out the elixir in the pot, put it in the palm of his hand and looked at it, which made him smile.
Unexpectedly, the elixir directly changed from useless elixir to purple quality.
In his deduction, the most likely thing was to become a green spiritual product, but he never thought that it would directly become a mysterious product. This was somewhat inconsistent with the previous deduction. After all, the 'Rejuvenation Pill' was definitely more precious than the 'Bigu Pill'.
In particular, this kind of treatment elixir can also slightly adjust the required medicinal materials to achieve unexpected effects. Some of the best elixirs can even have the effect of reviving human flesh and bones, which are called nine-turn elixirs.
Of course, these are all what I heard from Dan Cheng, and I don’t know whether they are true or false.
According to him, the elixir is divided into nine rounds, corresponding to the four qualities of the elixir. According to Chen Xuan's understanding, the so-called nine rounds refer to the number of repeated purifications. One purification is a mortal elixir, two or three times is a spiritual elixir, four to six times is a mysterious elixir, and six or more times is an elixir.
It is also directly linked to the quality of the finished pill, but it is not a decisive factor.
For example, when Elder Huo was refining the elixir, he had obviously gone through the fourth round of the process, but only got two mysterious elixirs. It can be seen that the number of purifications does not directly determine the quality of the elixir.
The reason why waste elixirs appear is that they have been purified too many times, resulting in some elixirs that lacked enough spiritual energy to directly lose their medicinal properties.
Chen Xuan thought carefully and summed up his experience.
I have decided that I will take the path of alchemy in the future. Currently, there are only two ways to maximize the use of clay pots:
The first is to refine elixirs. Even if they are made into useless elixirs, the quality of the elixirs can still be guaranteed.
The second is weapon refining, which is the same as alchemy refining.
However, the refining weapon must be attached with a small array pattern after all, which has higher requirements for mana control and technique. If the array pattern is destroyed, you can only get an enhanced version of an ordinary object, which is of little significance to the Qi Refiner.
In this way, the general direction for the future has been determined. What is needed now is to find a way to go down the mountain, buy a few books on alchemy, and then use the waste elixir to enrich the card library.
Speaking of the arsenal of trump cards, I am still short of money now. All I can get is a clay pot, the pendant given by Luan Qingping, and a few ordinary pills.
If you want to get along in the world of immortality, in addition to being cautious, you also need to have trump cards. Of course, only the trump cards that are unknown to others are the trump cards, and the ones that are known to others are at most the bright cards.
Right now, the most important thing is to deal with the 'difficult aunt' who is coming today.
Chen Xuan retracted his thoughts, took out all the contents in the clay pot, hid it in the gap between the beds, pushed the clay pot under the bed, then opened the door and walked out.
The door to Dancheng's room was still closed, it was too early.
Chen Xuan was not idle either. He checked the alchemy furnace again and then started to carry firewood into the alchemy room.
Su Ruoyan did not learn the fire control spell like Elder Huo, so she still had to use ordinary mortal methods to refine elixirs, so firewood became an indispensable item.
This was also one of the main reasons why Chen Xuan chose to start with Alchemy. He could burn firewood and refine it without mana. As for stimulating the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, he was able to do it not long after he became synaesthetic.
His requirements are not high, as long as he can refine the waste elixir.
I was thinking about this while moving firewood, and suddenly I had a bold and unconstrained idea:
I wonder if the materials required for alchemy can be directly turned into elixirs by putting them into a clay pot?
Well...it's worth a try!
It’s all a matter of course.
Chen Xuan moved firewood again and again, and soon he piled a pile of firewood as high as one person next to the alchemy stove.
At this time, Tan Chengcai came late and yawned into the alchemy room.
Seeing that Chen Xuan had stacked the firewood, he couldn't help but smile, walked over and patted his shoulder, "Well done, brother!"
Chen Xuan covered his forehead and smiled. Seeing that Dan Cheng had big dark circles under his eyes, he asked, "Senior brother Dan, what are you doing? Didn't you sleep last night?"
"Hey, don't mention it!"
DanHe waved his hand, winked, held the alchemy furnace with one hand, and said, "Last night, Elder Huo's words were all in my mind, which made me overly excited. I couldn't sleep all night, so I just meditated and practiced all night, but I made no progress. It's so difficult to build the foundation level!"
"Brother, come on, I believe you can do it!"
